title: The control-plane doc calls operational records immutable while live, but a grant row's state changes
outcome: The control-plane doc calls operational records immutable while live, but a grant row's state changes
acceptance: docs/features/behavioral-control-plane.md no longer says operational records or grants are immutable while live without qualification, in its "Durable control records" section or in its "Evaluate a turn" grant paragraph; it says which part is immutable (the grant's intent binding, grant_json) and that a grant row's state moves issued, begun, completed or expired or superseded

That grant paragraph no longer says a begun grant stays durable only until checkpoint (grants stay stored in every state; nothing prunes them), nor that grant supersession emits a canonical event (a supersession is recorded in the operational supersession table)

completion.summary:
Landed in 240e4c7 on master, in the crl changeset. behavioral-control-plane.md no longer calls operational records or grants immutable while live, in either "Durable control records" or the "Evaluate a turn" grant paragraph:
- A grant's intent binding (grant_json) is immutable, while its row's state moves from issued to begun and completed, or to expired or superseded.
- Grants stay stored in every state.
- A supersession is an operational record, not a canonical event.

Acceptance is revision 2, which Fable accepted. Evaluation 13bad804 passed 3/3.
